name: Character Swap
summary: Replace the main person in a photo using a second reference photo while retaining the original scene. Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo Q4, memory-bounded 512px preview.

source.notes: Cloud9 actual two-reference character replacement passed direct visual review (672x384, 439.59s); native Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo Q4 and 8-step schedule. Scope: one clearly described subject, two distinct images, preview resolution. See qualification receipt.

inputs.label: Replacement instructions
inputs.help: Describe the person to replace and what must remain unchanged (scene, pose, clothes, framing). Use one clear reference photo of the replacement person.

bind.template: Edit the first image. Replace its main person with the person in the second image, including face, hair, and body. Keep the first image background, composition, pose, clothing, perspective and lighting. Photorealistic seamless replacement. {details}
